# Selection right exactly where what matters is read

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-right-exactly-where-read` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](selection-right-exactly-where-read.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> What matters goes alike across a map's lumping exactly where it is read off the map, so some selection through the map selects exactly what matters exactly where the map reads it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. What matters goes alike across the alternatives a map lumps together exactly where it is read off the map, through what holds of some alternative the map gives that entry. (`Becoming.Learning.through_iff_reads`)
2. A selection through a map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly where what matters is read off the map. (`Becoming.Learning.selects_right_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; any types of alternatives and entries.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which map a selector uses.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
